rationale: The replication successfully verified the pseudospin SU(2) algebra, the analytic form of the OIFE field h_m coupling linearly to the magnetic octupole, its helicity (ζ²) origin, the h_m/Γ³=9/8 proportionality, and the van Vleck mechanism generating a static octupolar field. However, the many-body ED/DMRG phase diagram (AFO/FO/PPFQ/IO/ML phases in Fig.8) — a central result of the paper — was not attempted. Additionally, the absolute magnitude of the anisotropy Γ³/J_eff is ~100× smaller than Fig.3(a) suggests, indicating incomplete parameter specification. The headline mechanism is confirmed but key quantitative and phase-diagram claims remain unverified.
